1  DIST: VIJAYAPURA - 586 101.
 ...RESPONDENT  THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 74 (1) OF RIGHT TO  FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND  ACQUISITION, REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT,
 2013,

PRAYING TO CALL FOR THE RECORDS IN  L.A.C.NO.876/2018 PASSED BY THE LEARNED III ADDITIONAL  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:2941-DB  MFA No.202574 of 2023 DISTRICT JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL LAND ACQUISITION REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT AUTHORITY,
VIJAYAPURA DATED 06.07.2022 AND ALLOW THE ABOVE APPEAL AND TO SET ASIDE THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 06.07.2022 IN L.A.C.NO.876/2018 PASSED BY THE LEARNED III ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL LAND ACQUISITION REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT AUTHORITY, VIJAYAPURA, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.
 THIS MFA COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT On 15.02.2024, this Court has passed the following order:
"On the request of Sri.Mallikarjun C. Basareddy, the learned Government Advocate,
finally three weeks is allowed for compliance with the office objections.
Further, it is observed that if the objections are not attended within this period the appeal must be listed for orders on dismissal for default.

The office is directed to re-list this appeal after three weeks."
NC: 2024:KHC-K:2941-DB
Inspite of providing sufficient time, the learned Government Advocate has not complied the office objections till today.

Therefore, in view of the order dated 15.02.2024,
the appeal stands dismissed for default.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
